Only that test file changed: the check now uses device coordinates, preserves contact/nonpenetration checks, and checks both width boundaries and connector travel. blender.scope: All exported integer-frame native samples, exact CAD-part inventories and visibility, and scene object/action isolation. CAD millimetres become metres with a global X half-turn. Quaternion sign continuity is checked between samples. No continuous-time interpolation, collision, physics, or source-CAD freshness certification is claimed.

limits: Geometric design/inspection result only: no received-part fit, fastening torque, PA12 stiffness/creep, adhesive retention or flight qualification.
Slots cover declared pitches and clearances; they do not qualify arbitrary devices, fastener stacks or simultaneous payloads. M3-width arcs need suitable bearing hardware.
Single-axis optical trim assumes a lower-centreline rail. The modeled facing and documented removal path apply; no roll trim or self-levelling.
Direct MG-F10-A helix requires battery-host optical. Optional power combinations must follow their saved per-plan permitted host report. Remote antenna hardware remains unmodeled.
Modeled printed volumes and provisional density estimates are not measured all-up mass. Wire reservations and rigid-body animations are not flexible-cable dynamics or hardware qualification.
